subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should #101763 be handled as hosted Molty deployment/account-state repair, or is the hosted Brain & Keys path backed by current OpenClaw source and still capable of sending label-derived Anthropic ids or ignoring provider selections?
rationale: Current main’s normal UI/gateway path appears correct, but the reporter’s hosted-only evidence is a blocked first-run path without CLI/log access and only a hosted owner can inspect the deployed payload and state boundary.

options.title: Inspect hosted Molty first
options.body: Verify the deployed Brain & Keys request payload, session patch response, stored workspace overrides, and runtime provider/model values before choosing a code fix.

options.title: File a source regression
options.body: If hosted Molty is running current source and still sends label-derived ids or provider-agnostic fallbacks, turn this into a focused source repair against the Brain & Keys/session-patch path.

options.title: Route to hosted support
options.body: If usemolty.com owns the failing path outside this repository, close or transfer with hosted-service remediation steps and user-visible recovery guidance.

recommendation.title: Inspect hosted Molty first
recommendation.body: Verify the deployed Brain & Keys request payload, session patch response, stored workspace overrides, and runtime provider/model values before choosing a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest verified history connects this owner to both the Anthropic Opus 4.8 catalog addition and adjacent Control UI model-selection work.
